quests.title: Look to the right
quests.ask: Fill in `right_is_clear()`. Facing up with a hurdle on its right, it should give back `False`, and leave the robot on its cell, facing the same way.
quests.nudge: After it looks, which way is the robot facing? Which way should it face?

quests.title: Over a low hurdle
quests.ask: Fill in `jump()`: from just before a one-cell hurdle, facing east (→), end on the track just past it, facing east again.
quests.nudge: Trace the robot's path with your finger: up, over, down. Where does each part stop?

quests.title: Over a hurdle of any height
quests.ask: Fill in `jump()` so it also clears a hurdle two cells tall, ending on the track just past it, facing east (→).
quests.nudge: How can the robot tell it has climbed high enough to go over?
